Summary of the 10-Q filed August 7, 2025. Cited figures are marked; the original filing is the authoritative source.

Block, Inc. (XYZ) reported second-quarter 2025 total net revenue of $6.05 billiona, down from **$6.16 billion** a year earlier, as bitcoin revenue fell **$467.7 million** to **$2.14 billion**.
